tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.bank: Plug into the top of a Relay attached to an antenna to allow inserted channels to be repeated.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.card: Tune in a radiosmithing station, then right-click a Repeater Bank to insert.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.transponde: Plug into a Relay. Left card to right cards; click the display to toggle simplex/duplex.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.nether_foc: Install in a Relay to project reception and broadcast at matching Nether coordinates, at the roof.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.end_focus: Install in a Relay to project reception and broadcast at matching End coordinates, at the bottom.
tooltip.simpleradio_repeaters.amplifier: Install in a Relay to reset carrier decay to its catalyst-scaled tower strength. Audio degradation remains.
